stumbles.quote: Lock screen rotation in portrait. The game tells you when to turn the phone to landscape, so the operating system should not rotate the screen on its own.
stumbles.why: Step 1 says to open the game upright, but the game is then played in landscape. It is unclear how the game shows landscape while rotation is locked, and the instruction seems to clash with turning the phone to landscape later.

stumbles.quote: Tilt the top of the phone away from you to accelerate.
stumbles.why: After you turn to landscape, it is unclear which edge counts as the 'top' of the phone. The text also doesn't say whether left/right tilt means rolling the phone or turning it.

stumbles.quote: Hold the phone in the position you want to drive from while the start lights count down.
stumbles.why: It doesn't say how long the countdown lasts or whether the phone must be in landscape by then. It also doesn't say what happens if you misjudge the neutral position, or whether you can recalibrate.

point: To play, lock portrait rotation, pick your options, tap 'Start engine', turn to landscape, and hold a comfortable neutral position until the lights go out. Then tilt to steer, accelerate and brake.
